title: BB Docs page front matter
description: The YAML block at the very top of every content/**/*.md page, between two lines of ---. Validated in CI by tools/check_frontmatter.php; the website refuses to serve a page whose front matter does not validate.

title.description: Shown as the page heading, in the index and in the browser tab. Sentence case, no trailing period.

slug.description: The public URL of the page: /index.php?r=docs/<slug>. FLAT (no slash): the site's router cannot route a slash inside a slug. Unique across the whole repository. Changing a slug breaks every link to it — add the old one to redirect_from instead.

section.description: One of the section ids declared in docs.yml.

order.description: Position inside the section, ascending. Leave gaps of 10 so a page can be inserted without renumbering the others.

summary.description: One sentence, shown under the title on the index. No markup.

updated.description: The last date a human checked this page against the game or the site. NOT the last edit date (git already knows that, and the site shows it): this is the review date, and it is fine for it to be older than the last commit if the edit was a typo fix.

icon.description: Optional single emoji shown next to the title.

legacy_anchors.description: Anchors of the OLD single-page docs (#sec-coins, #wiki-basics, ...) that used to point at this text. The site uses them to forward stale links to this page. Never reuse one on two pages.

redirect_from.description: Former slugs of this page. The site answers them with a redirect to the current slug.

sources.description: Where this page's text comes from, when it is adapted from someone else's work. CC BY-SA 4.0 is share-alike WITH attribution: a page that reuses a community wiki article names it, and the site prints it in the page footer. https only, one URL per source.
sources.$comment: The gameplay and captain pages are adapted from the Free Biter Battles Wiki (freebb.miraheze.org), itself CC BY-SA 4.0 and written by its contributors.

vars.description: Names of the {{placeholders}} this page is allowed to contain. A placeholder is a number or a date the website fills in at render time (a queue size, a lock time) because it changes without an edit. Every {{name}} in the body must be listed here, and every name listed here should appear in the body. Content-only: a placeholder can never produce markup.
